notes.title: Haggard onion shaped torment scientist provides comment on state of online play
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings lab assistants![/h2]
A quick update for those who don't follow my discord or devstreams. 

If the public alpha has taught me anything, Little Hellions [i]needs[/i] online play. Like ~ [i]good[/i] online play. From it's necessity during the height of the pandemic, to simply bringing players together, it couldn't be clearer. 

But such a change is a massive undertaking, and why I have been noncommittal up until now. In order to make it happen, a complete overhaul of architecture will have to occur ~ and until recently that simply wasn't possible for a solo developer like myself. But possibilities are opening up. Currently, I'm exploring [url=https://platformfighterengine.github.io/#/]Platform Fighter Engine[/url]; a framework built for Game Maker, the engine Little Hellions already uses. PFE has built-in [url=https://youtu.be/0NLe4IpdS1w?si=ggB_C7msY0QlibZo]rollback netcode[/url] and a litany of quality of life features. It's a promising avenue since I wouldn't have to switch engines!

I am currently pursuing external funding in order to support this change, be it finding a publisher, applying for grants and so on. Normally devs don't share this sort of information, there's a lot of inside baseball to it, but I think transparency is important in this case as ~for the time being~ [u]updates for the current version of Little Hellions will slow down as I pursue these avenues[/u].

I apologize that Little Hellions continues to be a slow production, but I truly believe it in the best interest of the game in the long term. Couch multiplayer ~as much as I don't want it to be~ isn't really a thing anymore. [b]Of course[/b], all versions of the game going forward will still support it, but I want to make the game accessible to anyone who is willing to give a try, even if they don't have friends close by to play it with.

Nonetheless, thank you for supporting Little Hellions and drop a comment if you have any questions! 

Until next time, [b] Bomb Pig loves you! [/b]❤️

notes.title: Orientation program instated for new and confused Underworlders
notes.content:
[h1]Update time[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42795207/ec9842921409a705bc2c13fb6145d0a83d971f39.png"][/img][/p][p]Professor Onion here! Reporting from Torment Labs ~ a division of the Schadenfreude network.

First update with new content for a bit (rather than quality of life fixes) I'm looking forward to making that the case going forward. The new stage, 'Just Pull For it', is all about grabbing grapple points to move the trap around the level. I think it turned out pretty good! Lemme know what you think.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42795207/8692c213e30d68774b3e605db1fb4bd2be3cf827.png"][/img][/p][h2]Patch notes[/h2][h3]Onboarding[/h3][list][*][p] I'm in the game! I give a quick primer for new players after character selection.[/p][/*][*][p] Starting the Hellevator requires using it's grapple-point. No more jumping in by mistake.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Stages[/h3][list][*][p] New stage, Just Pull For It![/p][/*][*][p] Get To The Chopper removed (it was retooled into Edge Lords in the previous update).[/p][/*][*][p] Pressing Affairs renamed to Locomotion. Narrow & Marrow renamed to Pressing Affairs.[/p][/*][*][p] Geometry adjusted in Pressing Affairs.[/p][/*][*][p] Platforms added to Hot & Bothered.[/p][/*][*][p] Bone Yard stages sorted by difficulty.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Items[/h3][list][*][p] The Wrecking Ball is now the Iron Maiden, look at this goober.[/p][/*][*][p] Iron maidens rebound off the edge of the screen rather than wrapping.[/p][/*][*][p] Item drop chances adjusted.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Visuals[/h3][list][*][p] Trick-hooks are shown as long as they're active. You'll be able to turn this off in the options in a future update.[/p][/*][/list][p]That's it this time, [b]Bomb Pig loves you! ~ ❤[/b][/p]

notes.title: Keyboard support added upon dawn of new demo
notes.content: [h1]Greetings GAMERS![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42795207/ec9842921409a705bc2c13fb6145d0a83d971f39.png"][/img][/p][p]Professor Onion here. Gonna be brief with this one, I gotta eat BABY.  [/p][p]Your quality of life is going up! Check the patch notes below to see how. Additionally, there is an updated version of the demo, give it a try if you wanna give the game a spin (dunno why you're reading this if that's the case but hey I see you).  [/p][p][/p][h2]Patch notes[/h2][h3]Input[/h3][list][*][p] Keyboard + mouse support added![/p][/*][*][p] Pretty much all controller types supported.[/p][/*][*][p] Completely revised control remapper.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Quality of life[/h3][list][*][p] Players may drop out during character select.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Stages[/h3][list][*][p] Removed 'The Pit' cuz it sucked, added 'Edge Lords'.[/p][/*][*][p] Schadenfreude stages reordered.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Visuals[/h3][list][*][p] Players numbers are always displayed for increased readability.[/p][/*][*][p] Adding post processing effects for lava & water. Not all of it is in there yet.[/p][/*][*][p] Flippers are a little juicier to interact with.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bugs[/h3][list][*][p] Removed some crashes, don't worry about it.[/p][/*][/list][p]That's it this time, [b]Bomb Pig loves you! ~ ❤[/b][/p]
